entries.title: Joshua 19:1
segments: ¶The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

entries.title: Joshua 19:2
segments: They had in their inheritance Beersheba (Sheba), Moladah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:3
segments: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

entries.title: Joshua 19:4
segments: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:5
segments: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:6
segments: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen: thirteen cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 19:7
segments: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: four cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 19:8
segments: and all the villages that [were] all around these cities as far as Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:9
segments: The inheritance of the children of Simeon [was included] in the share of the children of Judah, for the share of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had [their] inheritance within the inheritance of that people.

entries.title: Joshua 19:10
segments: ¶The third lot came out for the children of Zebulun according to their families, and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.

entries.title: Joshua 19:11
segments: Their border went toward the west and to Maralah, went to Dabbasheth, and extended along the brook that is east of Jokneam.

entries.title: Joshua 19:12
segments: Then from Sarid it went eastward toward the sunrise along the border of Chisloth Tabor, and went out toward Daberath, bypassing Japhia.

entries.title: Joshua 19:13
segments: And from there it passed along on the east of Gath Hepher, toward Eth Kazin, and extended to Rimmon, which borders on Neah.

entries.title: Joshua 19:14
segments: Then the border went around it on the north side of Hannathon, and it ended in the Valley of Jiphthah El.

entries.title: Joshua 19:15
segments: Included were Kattath, Nahallal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:16
segments: This [was] the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:17
segments: ¶The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:18
segments: And their territory went to Jezreel, and [included] Chesulloth, Shunem,

entries.title: Joshua 19:19
segments: Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,

entries.title: Joshua 19:20
segments: Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,

entries.title: Joshua 19:21
segments: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

entries.title: Joshua 19:22
segments: And the border reached to Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth Shemesh; their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:23
segments: This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:24
segments: ¶The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:25
segments: And their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

entries.title: Joshua 19:26
segments: Alammelech, Amad, and Mishal; it reached to Mount Carmel westward, along [the Brook] Shihor Libnath.

entries.title: Joshua 19:27
segments: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon; and it reached to Zebulun and to the Valley of Jiphthah El, then northward beyond Beth Emek and Neiel, bypassing Cabul [which was] on the left,

entries.title: Joshua 19:28
segments: including Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

entries.title: Joshua 19:29
segments: And the border turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and ended at the sea by the region of Achzib.

entries.title: Joshua 19:30
segments: Also Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob [were included]: twenty-two cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:31
segments: This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:32
segments: ¶The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:33
segments: And their border began at Heleph, enclosing the territory from the terebinth tree in Zaanannim, Adami Nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum; it ended at the Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 19:34
segments: From Heleph the border extended westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there toward Hukkok; it adjoined Zebulun on the south side and Asher on the west side, and ended at Judah by the Jordan toward the sunrise.

entries.title: Joshua 19:35
segments: And the fortified cities [are] Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

entries.title: Joshua 19:36
segments: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

entries.title: Joshua 19:37
segments: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

entries.title: Joshua 19:38
segments: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh: nineteen cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:39
segments: This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:40
segments: ¶The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:41
segments: And the territory of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

entries.title: Joshua 19:42
segments: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Jethlah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:43
segments: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

entries.title: Joshua 19:44
segments: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

entries.title: Joshua 19:45
segments: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

entries.title: Joshua 19:46
segments: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the region near Joppa.

entries.title: Joshua 19:47
segments: And the border of the children of Dan went beyond these, because the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem and took it; and they struck it with the edge of the sword, took possession of it, and dwelt in it. They called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

entries.title: Joshua 19:48
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:49
segments: ¶When they had made an end of dividing the land as an inheritance according to their borders, the children of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.title: Joshua 19:50
segments: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked for, Timnath Serah in the mountains of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt in it.

entries.title: Joshua 19:51
segments: These [were] the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel divided as an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. So they made an end of dividing the country.
